svg.title: The exact-rule envelope on the fundamental spherical triangle
svg.text: 1. The lower envelope on the fundamental spherical triangle (exact rule, W = 3)
gnomonic coordinates u = n_y/n_x , v = n_z/n_x
One triangle is the whole sphere
Grey cell walls = the winning witness
of ε*(n). Peaks sit at cell corners.
Exactly three local maxima above 0.002, each a TRIPLE tie — three witnesses of equal cost, the 3D analogue of 2D's two-witness
crossover. The global max is (1,1,0)/(1,1,1)/(2,1,1); the threshold rule's max sits elsewhere because (2,2,1) is admissible there.
